title: Decision Table: Latest Review Rating and Temporary For-Hire Permit Acceptance
content:
**Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing.** The rating a Wayfare driver showed at the latest rating review bears on the temporary permit acceptance days, the calendar days from the upload day for which a temporary for-hire permit is accepted as the for-hire permit on file.

## Rule

When the rating at the latest rating review is at least 4.90, the temporary permit acceptance days gain 6 days; when it is at least 4.85 but below 4.90, they gain 3 days; when it is below 4.85, they gain none. Ratings are compared at two decimal places as recorded.

## Table

| Rating at the latest rating review on the standing record | Days gained |
|---|---|
| 4.90 or higher | 6 |
| 4.85 to 4.89 | 3 |
| 4.84 or lower | 0 |

## Edge readings (hypothetical)

| Latest review rating | Days gained |
|---|---|
| 4.90 | 6 |
| 4.89 | 3 |
| 4.85 | 3 |
| 4.84 | 0 |
